items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: Ben Boyden, saxophone player, said, let's you and I organize a band... So we done that. And I stayed around about four years, just playing the piano with the band

ctx.x: Did you ever take up the guitar? No, I never take up the guitar.

Because when, after I left that part of the country up there, and I came down there, it was around, getting around in the Depression time, and the people were putting the banjoes down for the ghettos. And I wasn't able to buy a ghetto, so I went back on the piano. And while I was before, while I was up around Monroe, there was some fine banjo players up there I met. And so after these, these majestic ramblers broke up, so Ben Boyden, saxophone player, said, let's you and I organize a band. I said, man, I want you…
